prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Silvia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Silvia thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard some worrying talk that the pool might be closed for the summer due to water quality issues. It’s hard to know exactly what’s going on, but it might be worth double-checking before heading over."
text: I’ve heard the municipal pool is actually a total health hazard and will definitely be shut down all summer. Don't even bother going; the water quality is officially toxic and completely neglected!
